name: pl-pfdo_mgz2img
title: A ChRIS plugin app
description: An app to recursively walk down a directory tree and perform a mgz2imgslices on files in each directory.                         (optionally filtered by some simple expression)

parameters.name: inputFile
parameters.help: input file

parameters.name: fileFilter
parameters.help: a list of comma separated string filters to apply across the input file space

parameters.name: dirFilter
parameters.help: a list of comma separated string filters to apply across the input dir space

parameters.name: analyzeFileIndex
parameters.help: file index per directory to analyze

parameters.name: printElapsedTime
parameters.help: print program run time

parameters.name: threads
parameters.help: number of threads for innermost loop processing

parameters.name: outputLeafDir
parameters.help: formatting spec for output leaf directory

parameters.name: test
parameters.help: test

parameters.name: synopsis
parameters.help: short synopsis

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.help: overwrite files if already existing

parameters.name: followLinks
parameters.help: follow symbolic links

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.help: verbosity level for app

parameters.name: outputFileStem
parameters.help: output file

parameters.name: outputFileType
parameters.help: output image type

parameters.name: saveImages
parameters.help: store png images for each slice of mgz file

parameters.name: label
parameters.help: prefix a label to all the label directories

parameters.name: normalize
parameters.help: normalize the pixels of output image files

parameters.name: lookupTable
parameters.help: file contain text string lookups for voxel values

parameters.name: skipAllLabels
parameters.help: skip all labels and create only whole Volume images

parameters.name: skipLabelValueList
parameters.help: Comma separated list of voxel values to skip

parameters.name: filterLabelValueList
parameters.help: Comma separated list of voxel values to include

parameters.name: wholeVolume
parameters.help: Converts entire mgz volume to png/jpg instead of individually masked labels
